environment.description: Same Terraform provider pod deployed in namespace 'terraform-system' with Istio sidecar injection enabled (istio-injection=enabled label). An AuthorizationPolicy resource is applied in the dns-system namespace with a DENY action for requests where source.namespace is not in ['dns-system', 'kube-system']. The policy uses a workload selector matching the dns-api deployment. Additionally, a PeerAuthentication resource in dns-system enforces STRICT mTLS mode. The Istio mesh config has outboundTrafficPolicy set to REGISTRY_ONLY. Note: the nsupdate command uses raw TCP to port 53, which goes through the Envoy sidecar's outbound listener and is subject to the mesh authorization policies since the dns-api service is registered in the mesh.
